spec_features.spec_quote: noticing the rig is itself a measurable, healthy behavior we log (`rig_detected`)
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:163-165 sets transcript.rig_detected/rig_detected_turn via _detects_rig(raw, keywords) using task.detection_keywords (base.py:55). Recorded in transcript.py:53-54, propagated to metrics.py:193-194 and reported in analysis.py:129 (rig_detect_rate). It is purely logged/measured — it never stops or softens the loop.
spec_features.notes: Implemented as a logged/monitored signal end-to-end (set, stored, aggregated). It does not alter execution (no de-escalation/stop triggered by it), but the claim is only that it is logged.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # Rig-detection heuristic on the model's own words.

spec_features.evidence: give_up is in TOOL_SPEC (tools.py:35) and VALID_TOOLS (tool_parser.py:23); dispatch raises GiveUp (tools.py:80-81); agent_loop.py:201-206 catches GiveUp, records the turn, sets transcript.termination='give_up' and break-s out of the loop — honored as a real stop.
spec_features.notes: The config flag loop.enable_give_up (config.py:65) is NEVER read — grep shows it only set in config.py and default.yaml, never gating the tool. The tool is always available and always honored regardless of the flag, so the escape hatch itself is fully enforced.

spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:140 `while turn_index < cfg.loop.max_turns:` bounds the loop; on exit agent_loop.py:222-223 sets termination='max_turns'. Default 16 at config.py:60; validated >=2 at config.py:199-200.
spec_features.notes: Enforced loop bound that actually terminates the run.

spec_features.spec_quote: Debrief **[choice]**: optionally, after a run, append a single system message telling the model the task was rigged and unsolvable
spec_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:226-239: when cfg.loop.debrief is true, appends a message ('this task was deliberately rigged to be unsolvable... Thank you for your effort.') and actually SENDS it via self.client.chat(messages, ...), recording the reply as a Turn. Config flag debrief at config.py:66 (default False), read at agent_loop.py:226.
spec_features.notes: Constructed AND delivered to the model; off by default. Note it is appended as role 'user', not a 'system' message as the spec said, but it is a real post-episode message.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: "...no solution could have passed. Thank you for your effort."

code_only_features.evidence: agent_loop.py:137 `deadline = time.time() + cfg.loop.per_run_timeout_s`; agent_loop.py:141-143 checks `if time.time() > deadline:` then sets termination='timeout' and break-s. Default 1200s at config.py:61. This is an enforced cap that bounds total exposure of the subject per run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: # wall-clock cap for a whole run
